description:
List the estates the signed-in SwiftProbate user can work with: estates they own plus estates someone has shared with them as a collaborator. SwiftProbate is probate task-management software that helps executors and families organize and track the probate process. This tool requires sign-in and only reads; it never creates or changes anything.

When to use: before any other estate tool, because every estate tool (get_estate_summary, get_tasks, create_task, update_estate, and the rest) needs an estate_id that comes from here. Also use it when the user asks which estates are in their account.

When not to use: for a summary of an estate's details, assets, or progress, call get_estate_summary with the estate_id instead; this tool returns only ids and labels. General probate reference questions (county guides, state overviews, forms, institutions) do not need an estate.

Returns, when the user has estates: estates, a list where each item has estateId (pass it as estate_id), label (the deceased's name, or 'Unnamed estate'), role (owner, editor, or viewer), and canEdit (whether write tools are allowed; viewers can read but not edit). If there is more than one estate and the user has not said which, ask them to choose rather than guessing.

Returns, when the user has no estate yet: a plain-language message that leads the result, plus structured content with an empty estates list, setup_needed: true, setup_url, and consent_on_file. Follow the message and tell the user plainly there is no estate yet. If consent_on_file is true, offer to set one up (SwiftProbate builds a personalized probate checklist from a few questions). Only if they agree, call show_estate_setup, which shows a short setup form right in the chat; if that tool is not available, collect the details conversationally and call complete_onboarding. If consent_on_file is false, the user must first accept the Terms of Service and read the disclaimer on the website, so share setup_url instead.

Estate data reflects what the user and their collaborators have entered. SwiftProbate is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.
name: list_my_estates
